ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Bond-yield shock breaks the semiconductor winning streak
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: A much stronger U.S. flash composite PMI reading of 58.4 pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to 5.106%, its highest since 2007. SOX fell about 1.74%; NVIDIA, AMD and TSM ADR all declined, showing that discount-rate pressure temporarily overrode the recent AI-hardware momentum.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Microsoft plans more than $10 billion of Gulf cloud and AI investment through 2030
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported Microsoft plans to invest more than $10 billion across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait through 2030, including cloud and AI infrastructure, reinforcing continued hyperscaler infrastructure demand despite higher rates.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: TSMC ecosystem pushes A14, N2P/N3P and advanced packaging design readiness
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Synopsys and Cadence announced expanded TSMC collaborations spanning A14-certified design flows, N2P/N3P IP, CoWoS/3D-IC enablement and UALink-related capabilities. The read-through is continued design activity for next-generation AI/HPC systems rather than a demand freeze.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Trump-Xi summit becomes the near-term chip-policy risk event
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Xi arrived in Washington ahead of the September 24 summit. Reuters reported the U.S. is open to extending the trade truce, while broad AI cooperation is considered unlikely. Markets are watching export controls, AI-safety mechanisms, critical minerals and tariff policy.

ai_news_coverage_note: No comparably material new NVIDIA-, AMD- or Apple-specific product/earnings announcement was verified inside the strict last-24-hour window. Their market impact today is therefore represented primarily through same-date price action and the macro/policy catalysts above rather than recycled older news.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. growth surprise sends 10-year yield above 5.1% and hits growth stocks
breaking_news.market_impact: S&P Global flash composite PMI rose to 58.4, the strongest since July 2021. The U.S. 10-year yield jumped roughly 13.9 bps to 5.106%, while S&P 500 fell 0.75%, Nasdaq 1.13%, Dow 0.68% and Russell 2000 1.77%.

breaking_news.headline: Oil rebounds on renewed Iran risk
breaking_news.market_impact: WTI settled at $92.16, up $1.64 or 1.81%, while Brent settled at $103.08. The oil rebound reinforced inflation risk just as Treasury yields moved to cycle highs.

breaking_news.headline: Taiwan index closes above 48,000 for the first time, but U.S. selloff hits TX night session
breaking_news.market_impact: TAIEX closed at a record 48,157.29 (+0.75%) with foreign cash buying of about NT$37.313B, but the 2026-09-24 TX night session closed at 47,909, down 403 points versus reference after U.S. yields and tech shares reversed.

earnings_summary.last_24h: General Mills fiscal Q1 net sales were $4.3895B (-3%) with adjusted diluted EPS $0.75 (-13% constant currency), while the company reaffirmed FY2027 guidance. Cintas fiscal Q1 revenue was $3.01B (+10.9%), adjusted diluted EPS $1.39 (+15.8%), and it raised FY2027 revenue and adjusted EPS guidance. Paychex fiscal Q1 revenue was $1.6305B (+6%) and adjusted EPS $1.34 (+10%); it maintained total revenue growth and adjusted EPS growth outlooks while raising PEO/Insurance growth guidance.
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: General Mills reaffirmed organic net sales of -1.5% to +0.5%, adjusted operating profit -13% to -8%, and adjusted EPS $3.00-$3.20. Cintas raised FY2027 revenue guidance to $12.15B-$12.27B and adjusted EPS to $5.45-$5.54. Paychex kept total revenue growth at 5%-6% and adjusted EPS growth at 7%-9%, raised PEO/Insurance Solutions growth to 7%-8%, and raised client-funds interest to $200M-$210M. Next major reports: Darden before the Sep24 open and Costco after the Sep24 close.

video_120s_sequence.narration: 美國成長數據太強，十年債殖利率一口氣衝上5.106%，創2007年以來新高；前六日強勢的半導體立刻反轉，今天市場焦點從AI需求轉回折現率。
S&P 500跌0.75%、Nasdaq跌1.13%、Dow跌0.68%、Russell 2000跌1.77%，VIX升到約15.18。Nasdaq雖仍在52週區間約94.7%的高檔，但高利率開始測試估值。
DXY升到101.12，黃金回落約1.6%至每盎司4294美元；WTI反彈1.81%至92.16美元。油價和殖利率一起往上，是今天風險資產最不利的組合。
SOX跌1.74%至12469點，NVIDIA跌1.47%、AMD跌1.82%、台積電ADR跌1.20%。不過AMD仍在52週區間約97%，所以目前更像高估值遇到利率衝擊，還不能直接解讀成AI需求反轉。
基本面仍有支撐：Microsoft宣布到2030年前在海灣地區投入超過100億美元雲端與AI基礎建設；TSMC與Synopsys、Cadence持續推進A14、N2與先進封裝設計工具。
台股日盤反而創收盤新高48157點，外資現貨買超約373億元；但美股回落後，台指期9月24日夜盤收47909點、下跌403點。外資日盤淨空單仍有76084口。
企業財報分化：Cintas上修全年營收與獲利展望，Paychex維持全年成長目標，General Mills則面對成本壓力但重申全年財測。今晚接著看Darden與Costco。
接下來三個關鍵：十年債能否跌回5%以下、川習會是否牽動晶片出口限制，以及今晚初領失業金與新屋銷售是否延續經濟過熱訊號。若殖利率站穩5%以上，AI估值壓力會繼續放大。

key_takeaways: The dominant cross-asset signal is the U.S. 10-year yield at 5.106%, not an AI-demand collapse. Strong PMI and higher oil revived inflation/Fed-hike risk.
Semiconductors corrected sharply but AMD remains near the top of its 52-week range and Microsoft/TSMC ecosystem announcements still point to ongoing AI infrastructure investment.
Taiwan cash remained strong at a record close, but the TX night session reversed to 47,909 after the U.S. rate shock; foreign futures positioning remained heavily net short.
The September 24 Trump-Xi summit is the largest near-term policy risk for NVIDIA, AMD, TSMC, Apple and Microsoft via chip controls, AI rules, tariffs and critical minerals.
